title: Dashboard per-project config
description: Generated by scaffold.sh into <project>/dashboard/config.json at scaffold time. Never hardcoded into the dashboard template itself — see the template-repo concept's config.schema.json spec.

factory_log_path.description: Path to .specify/factory-log.md, relative to the project root.

tasks_path.description: Path to the active feature's tasks.md. Absent or nonexistent is a valid fresh-scaffold state (BE-AC3).

constitution_path.description: Path to .specify/memory/constitution.md, relative to the project root.

cmux_socket_path.description: Override for CMUX_SOCKET_PATH, if not using cmux's default (/tmp/cmux.sock). Optional.
